BrochureContent.Content: Bowe Property presents to the market a beautiful detached family home within an exclusive residential enclave, The Grove, with just six private homes in a private cul-de-sac location. Just 4km from Innishannon, less than 300m from Crossbarry village, and 14km from Bishopstown and the western suburbs of Cork City, No.3 is a flawless example of a home that has been well designed and superbly appointed with beautiful updated features since its inception 20 years ago. The property sits on an very private gated site extending to approximately half an acre, and the property hides its impressive scale through great design. The main residence, has a living area of approximately 330 sqm, is further complemented by a detached gym and a detached garage. The property has been fastidiously maintained by its owners and boast an impressive B2 energy rating, courtesy of progressive investment by the owners with solar PV, a wood pellet heating system with zoned heating throughout, within an energy cabin plant room housing all the property's energy needs with a fully automated backup generator. Accommodation over three floors consists of five bedrooms, three ensuites, together with two reception rooms, a formal dining area, home office, attic/den, two bathrooms and a guest w.c and a truly beautiful open-plan kitchen/dining/garden conservatory, further complemented by a separate utility room. The accommodation is accessed over a series of three different staircases, with all family living areas on the first floor, incorporating four fine bedrooms and two en suites, together with a self-contained aupair/guest room located on the first floor with access from the main family lounge. The property has a host of impressive and beautiful features, and the Nicholas Moody commissioned fitted kitchen and island unit is quite simply breathtaking. This handcrafted and hand-painted kitchen has been designed and commissioned with practicality and ease of use in mind, with significant storage and drawer systems, premium appliances including a Britannia professional stove oven and gas hob a fully integrated Fisher & Paykel island freezer/cooler drawer, and an integrated fridge/freezer and dishwasher. A bespoke Frankie stainless steel sink with internal shelf, stone countertops with a feature curved island coffee counter with beautiful contrasting walnut and hand-painted cabinetry. The property has a range of smart home features incorporating Ring ,Nest & Hive brands, together with Hikvision CCTV security, a monitored alarm, automated gate with GSM and fob access, and further features such as wide plank hardwood floors, built-in robes, ceramic tiling, and solid fuel stoves. The property's setting within this low residential enclave, with superb privacy, extensive space, and access from almost every room on the ground floor, on the gardens and outside that makes this a truly beautiful home to live in. A detached log cabin gym, together with an energy plant room and a block-built garage, offers an insight into the quality and versatility of this beautiful home. The gardens are flawlessly landscaped, with large private lawned areas to the rear, together with open decking, extensive parking with electric car charging provided. This is a  beautiful home that hides its scale through good design, and the owners of this property have invested significant time, money, and love into a property that is both impressive and beautifully comfortable as standard throughout. A home that needs to be viewed to be fully appreciated, and viewings are now openly invited strictly by prior appointment with Bowe Property.
